description: Tombstones for DELETED memory-calibration evidence records (sc-18224).
Every consistency check over the calibration corpus verifies that artifacts agree
with each other; none of them can see that the corpus SHRANK, because a deletion
plus a matrix regeneration leaves everything self-consistent.
scripts/check-evidence-corpus.mjs closes that hole: it compares the record ids in
with origin/main and fails on any id that disappeared.
A legitimate deletion must be declared here — one entry per deleted record id,
with a human-readable reason and the story that authorized it. The entry is the
reviewable act: a PR that deletes evidence must also touch this file, so the
deletion is visible in review instead of vanishing behind a regeneration.
The gate also fails on a tombstone whose record still exists at HEAD, so stale or
premature entries cannot accumulate. Entries for long-gone records (the deletion
already merged) stay here as history; do not remove them.
Entry shape: { "id": "imc-<20 hex>", "reason": "why the record had to go", "story": "sc-NNNNN" }
